props.name: actions
props.comment: Extra commands. Use `useRegisterCommand` for ones that come and go.

props.name: children
props.comment: Rendered outside the dialog, so helpers can call `useRegisterCommand`.

props.name: hotkey
props.comment: Bindings that toggle the menu, as `"mod+k"`. `false` for none.

props.name: perResourceLimit
props.comment: Records fetched per resource for one search.

props.name: resources
props.comment: Names of the resources to list and search. Defaults to every resource.

props.name: searchDebounceMs
props.comment: Wait after the last keystroke before records are searched. Default `250`.

props.name: searchFields
props.comment: Filter key per resource for the record search. Defaults to `"q"`.
